name: Polar
summary: A developer-focused Merchant of Record for software, digital products, subscriptions, usage billing, and built-in benefits.

pricing.headline: Starter is 5% + $0.50; paid monthly plans lower the variable rate.
pricing.assumptions: Starter plan. International-card, dispute, payout, and some currency-conversion costs can apply.

sellerCoverage: Polar supports individual and business payouts in its published country list through Stripe Connect Express.
buyerCoverage: Payments are accepted globally except from documented sanctioned countries, subject to payment-method availability.
products: Eligible software, SaaS, digital products, subscriptions, usage-based products, and developer-oriented benefits.

features.checkout: Hosted and embedded checkout with API-created sessions.
features.subscriptions: Recurring, usage-based, seat-based, trial, and multi-currency pricing features.
features.invoicing: Automatic order invoices and EU B2B reverse-charge handling; advanced quoting should be verified for the use case.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, wallets, and local methods documented by Polar and its payment partners.
features.payouts: Stripe Connect Express payouts with documented payout and cross-border costs.

responsibilities.area: Indirect-tax calculation, registration, filing, and remittance
responsibilities.note: Polar describes itself as reseller and tax-liable seller for covered transactions.
Polar manages network exposure and charges a documented dispute fee.
The seller owns the product relationship; Polar can automate benefit grants.
Net payouts still require business accounting and income-tax reporting.

strengths: Built-in usage, seat, and entitlement features
limitations: Younger operating history than long-established providers
Coverage and registrations evolve with thresholds
Additional international, payout, and dispute costs matter
bestFor: SaaS needing usage or benefit-based billing
avoidIf: You require a long enterprise operating history
Your seller country or product is outside Polar policy
